config.record_grain: One row per ACNC-registered charity record, primarily identified by the source ABN; the row describes the charity record, its business address and charity attributes, not separate legal entities for other names.

fields.evidence: ACNC Registered Charities User guide, Dec 2024, p. 2 §§6-7: ABN is the charity's Australian Business Number and the field is numeric; exact header ABN and discovery sample 51214424410.

ACNC User guide, p. 2 §§12-14: the charity address is its business address and the supplied fields include Address line 1, 2 and 3; exact headers Address_Line_1, Address_Line_2, Address_Line_3 and sample 540 Regency Rd. Blank components are source blanks.
ACNC User guide, p. 2 §13 lists Town/City among the address fields; exact header Town_City and discovery sample Enfield.
ACNC User guide, p. 2 §13 lists State among the address fields; exact header State and discovery samples SA and VIC.

ACNC User guide, p. 2 §13 lists Postcode among the address fields; exact header Postcode and discovery sample 5085. The postcode operation preserves the source string and does not zero-pad damaged values.
ACNC User guide, p. 2 §13 lists Country among the address fields; exact header Country and discovery sample Australia.
ACNC User guide, p. 2 §15: Charity website contains the supplied website address; exact header Charity_Website and discovery samples https://www.u3ainnernorth.org.au/ and www.spectrum3.org.au.

unmapped_fields.reason: The field is documented as a formal charity name (ACNC User guide, p. 2 §§8-9), but no explicit current-name indicator or separately supported current-name field is present in the supplied schema. It is retained as the raw subject_label_field and is not emitted as a current entity.legal_name claim to avoid treating an unsupported or historical name as current.

ACNC User guide, p. 2 §§10-11 says this may contain one or more trading names or other names. The source does not establish the role for every value or provide a documented separator for multiple values; left unmapped rather than asserting entity.trading_name.
Source address-type label has no canonical ontology field; address_role=business is based on ACNC User guide, p. 2 §§12-14, without emitting this raw type.

limitations: The source envelope publication_proxy 2026-09-13T19:00:54.497199 is used as a dataset-level observed_at proxy; no record-level statement timestamp is supplied.
The dataset is updated weekly and only includes ACNC-registered charities; records or fields may be withheld, so absence is not evidence of nonexistence. ACNC User guide, p. 1 §§2-5.

Charity_Legal_Name is retained as the raw subject label but is not emitted as entity.legal_name because the supplied schema has no explicit current-name indicator or supported current-name field. Human review is required if the publisher documents such an indicator in the full release.
Other_Organisation_Names may contain trading names or other names and possibly multiple values; it is intentionally unmapped because role and separator are unsupported.
Registration_Date is ACNC charity registration, not legal-entity registration; no entity.date_registered, entity.status, entity.entity_type or liquidation claim is inferred.

No ACN, ARBN, reporting-group, industry-code or legal-entity registration field is supplied; none is inferred. All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional judgements requiring human review.
The frozen reader and partitions are retained unchanged.
